key_insight: TriGeoBench tests whether multimodal models understand geometric structure rather than rely on superficial visual patterns.
engineering_relevance: Paired figures and executable TikZ provide a testbed for evaluating structure-aware mathematical reasoning and image-to-code systems.
method: Construct question-answer, RGB figure, and TikZ triplets from Chinese school mathematics exams.
Cover plane, solid, analytic, function, and vector geometry with diverse response formats.
Evaluate open- and closed-source models using image-to-TikZ and multimodal reasoning probes.
evidence_signal: The benchmark contains 7,000 question-answer pairs and 12,235 figures; evaluations reveal persistent fine-grained structure and image-text alignment challenges.
watch_item: Oracle experiments use human-curated reference TikZ, so their benefits do not establish end-to-end image-to-TikZ reasoning performance.
paper_title: TriGeoBench: A Multimodal Mathematical Geometry Benchmark with Figures and TikZ
